name: ARTH 3580W
title: Image as Witness: Testimony, Witness, Confession
description: (Also offered as HRTS 3580W.) Explores the role of visual culture in bearing witness to human rights abuses.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011. Not open for credit to students who have passed ARTH 3995 when offered as "Image as Witness."
